generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tender will not be Considered

The successful bidder has to make his own arrangements for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials contractor should procure only. ISI mark materials and obtained necessary quality control certificates from the authorized quality control authority
The competent authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons
Tender processing amount will not be refundable
The Bidder have to produce all the original documents whenever employer calls for verification
The Bidders have to furnish their existing commitments and on going works in the enclosed formats.
The tenderer should maintain the work in good condition during defect liability period for 1(ONE) year from the date of completion of work at his cost
Transportation charges for the conveyance of all the samples collected for testing from the site of work to Q.C.Lab shall be borne by the contractor himself.
The contractor prices includes diversion, approach road for procurement of materials, dewatering etc. No claims shall be done for extra items/cost for the same
Contractors who have not completed the works in time in this division will not be entitled to Bid and if participated it will not be considered .

During the execution of works, if any minor minerals are required, contractors have to abide by the prevailing rules and Acts applicable to Minor Minerals. As per the prevailing rules, for any use of Minor Minerals, the contractor has to submit the Mineral Dispatch Permit (MDP) obtained from Mines and Geology Department. If Mineral Dispatch Permit (MDP) is not submitted by the contractor along with the bill, the prevailing penalty DMF contribution as per Karnataka Minor Mineral Concession rules 1994 (as ammended from time to time) will be deducted from the contractors bill.

The contractor should obtain the Material Dispatch Permit for stone, aggregates, sand and murrum etc will be used in the construction work from the Mines and Geology department at the time of execution and same should be submitted along with the work bill, then for such work bills no Royalty will be deducted. If the contractor failed to submit the Material Dispatch Permit along with the work bill Five times Royalty will be deducted from the work bill as per KMMCR 2016 amendment rule 44(4) and the circular vide No.Ga.Bhu.E/DCB/2024-25/20064 Dated : 28.01.2025 by Mines and Geology department
Restrictions on Public Procurement from Bidders of certain countries as per Government order No.FD 455 Exp-12 2020 Bengaluru dated:01-04-2023
Annual Turnover certificate, IT Returns and Balance sheet certified by CA with UDIN number for the last five years i.e.2021-22 to 2025-26 has to be enclosed.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
The Tenders are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document KW-1
All relevant documents as per the KW-1 need to be uploaded while submitting bid in general documents provision in KPP portal
The Intended Completion Date for the whole of the work is 06 months.
The successful bidder has to provide and fix Name Board near the site indicating details of the work
The scope of the work includes borewell,Erection of Pumpset, and Electrification works.
Detailed Nomenclature of the works can be obtained from the bid document uploaded with this tender and it will be the final.
One percent of the bill amount of the successful tenderer will be deducted towards cess as a labour welfare fund

The contractor shall quote the rates without adding GST for either material or works contracts (service). GST payable by the contractor under this works/contract will be paid to the contractor over and above the contractors bid amount.
IT and GST will be deducted as per Government order
Contractor should quote the rate excluding GST

In respect of this tender, the item rates are exclusive of GST. The amount put to tender is exclusive of GST. Accordingly the bidder shall quote rates without adding GST for either materials or works contract (Service).
For payments related to GST, contractor should abide to prevailing FD order No.FD 417 Exp-12/2024 Bengaluru dated:09.08.2024
While Commencing the work borewell shall be done first, thereafter successful of borewell, elctrification and Erection of Pumpset shall be done. Next Civil works shall be done.
Eligible contractors having Civil ,Electrical and Mescom Registration shall apply.
Contractor should get the RR No from the MESCOM after that only Bill will be paid.
Borewells shall be drilled by agencies registered with the Karnataka Groundwater Authority, Bengaluru. A valid Form-7A registration certificate issued by the competent authority shall be uploaded.
Deductions regarding GST, Royalty, MDP etc will be as per prevailing government orders
Post tender process shall be done in contract management module as per Government Order no: DPAR 154EGV Dated: 23.07.2024

In compliance with the directions of the Honorable Supreme Court in Writ Petition No. 36/2009 dated 06.08.2010 (Sl. No. IX), regarding failed borewells, it has been ordered that, filling up abandoned borewells by clay/sand/boulders/pebbles/drill cutting etc. from bottom to ground level. The Contractor shall be solely responsible for ensuring complete closure of all failed borewells in accordance with the above directions
For the failed borewells, no separate payment shall be made for the casing pipes either for material or for inserting and removing

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing irrigation facilities through borewell to the land of Somaya bin Nakkura Maipadka house in Badagabelluru village of Bantwala taluk in Dakshina Kannada district.

itemList.description: Supply of ISI mark 175mm nominal bore,plain and steel casing pipe grade of steel Fe 410 of wall thickness conforming to IS 4270-2001 and latest ammendments, electrical resistance welded steel tubes, material and conforming to IS 1387-1993 and manufactured by basic open hearth electric or basic oxygen process in random length of 5-7m both ends.threaded conforming to IS 554-1985 one end fixed with socket conforming to IS 4270-2001 and the other end with screwed pipes all shall be responsibaly free from defects. The tubes shall be responsible straight end should be with ISI marking weighing 25.10kg/m.prices include Collar-Medium duty, complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges as per the direction of Engineer in charge.

Providing and fixing MS casing collars as per IS 1239 (part-II) 1982 with all latest amendments if any for any dia. The thickness of plate used for covering one end shall be 3mm (minimum). The dimensions of caps and colars shall be strictly as per IS 1239 (Part-II) 1982 with all amendments, complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges as per the direction of Engineer in charge.

Providing and laying at site of work MS casing caps as per IS 1239 (part-II) 1982 with all latest amendments if any for any dia. The thickness of plate used for covering one end shall be 3mm (minimum). The dimensions of caps and colars shall be strictly as per IS 1239 (Part-II) 1982 with all amendments including cost of material and labour charges for fixing, if any etc. , complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges as per the direction of Engineer in charge.

Sinking of Borewell of 165mm dia clear using super fast hydraulic rig of capacity 300 PSIG & above 1100 CMF & above in all strata including over burdern upto 20 m. Fixing of casing pipes, collars and cap with necessary cutting, threading and welding including transportation of rig and supporting vehicle, crew charges and cost of consumables etc., complete including yield testing at the final depth with a minimum working of compressor for one hour (Excluding cost of casing pipes, collars, cap etc., complete) -For Borewell depth of 0 to 50 Mtrs, complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges as per the direction of Engineer in charge.

Sinking of Borewell of 165mm dia clear using super fast hydraulic rig of capacity 300 PSIG & above 1100 CMF & above in all strata including over burdern upto 20 m. Fixing of casing pipes, collars and cap with necessary cutting, threading and welding including transportation of rig and supporting vehicle, crew charges and cost of consumables etc., complete including yield testing at the final depth with a minimum working of compressor for one hour (Excluding cost of casing pipes, collars, cap etc., complete) -For Borewell depth of 50 to 100 Mtrs, complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges as per the direction of Engineer in charge.

Sinking of Borewell of 165mm dia clear using super fast hydraulic rig of capacity 300 PSIG & above 1100 CMF & above in all strata including over burdern upto 20 m. Fixing of casing pipes, collars and cap with necessary cutting, threading and welding including transportation of rig and supporting vehicle, crew charges and cost of consumables etc., complete including yield testing at the final depth with a minimum working of compressor for one hour (Excluding cost of casing pipes, collars, cap etc., complete) -For Borewell depth of 100 to 150 Mtrs, complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges as per the direction of Engineer in charge.

Geophysical investigation at site for sinking borewells for Providing drinking water to the habitation either through the Hand Pump MWS or P.W.S.S, by vertical electrical sounding by adopting Venner or Schlumbergers's method, including reconnaissance survey of geological formation. Geophysical investigation of existing ground water in the vicinity, its quality, quantity and acceptability of the users, indicating the location of the site, recommended depth of casing pipe required to seal the top unconsolidated formation including an extra depth of 1.0 metre in consolidated formation for proper seating of casing pipe, depth of drilling required to cover full depth of aquifer proposed to be tapped, probable yield and other information required including transportation of instruments and accessories to work site, engaging technical personal and labour required etc. NOTE: 1) Additional rate on item 1&2 is allowed for drilling in over burden and fixing Casing pipes beyond 20 M (for fixing Casing pipes only) a) Above 20 M and upto 30 M - 15%, b) Above 30 M - 30% (Measurement of overburden is restricted to the depth of casing pipe fixed excluding initial depth of 20M and projection above ground level). 2) A sum of Rs. 100/- is to be deducted for Dry Borewell towards yield test. etc., complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges as per the direction of Engineer in charge.

Providing Submersible Pump Set of 150mm dia suitable for bore well and confirming to IS 8034-2000;3Phase, SS Bowl & Impeller with Low volt Motor as per specifications, to work site as per necessary ammendments and instructions of engineer incharge of work. For 3 HP etc. complete-For 5.00 HP - 90 LPM @ 110 m = 15 STG Outlet Dia - 2.00", complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges as per the direction of Engineer in charge.

Supply and delivery of galvanized mild steel tubes of 6mtr standard length heavy duty (C Class) as per IS 1239 (Part-I) 1990 with latest amendments with ISI Mark (one end fitted with Heavy Duty collar and other end fitted with protective cover)-50 mm, complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges as per the direction of Engineer in charge.

Supply and delivery at site Brand new best make PVC insulated cable of Flat 3 core (sheathed) of nominal cross sectional area as per IS 694-1990 with ISI Mark and as per its latest amendments-1x3x4 Sqm, complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges as per the direction of Engineer in charge.

Supply and delivery at site of brand new best make non-return valve as per IS 778/1984 with ISI Mark and as per its latest amendments, complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges as per the direction of Engineer in charge.

Labour charges for Erection, Electrification and commissioning of Pump sets, including aligning and balancing of all items including supply and erection of two pair of supporting clamps, bore well caps, cable clips and water tight gland cable protectors, bolts, nuts, valve and gauges,tools and equipments etc., involved in the job as per specifications, with necessary tests as per specifications, with testing of as per instructions of engineer incharge of work, complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading charges as per the direction of Engineer in charge.
